sources.access: Original 20-page PDF downloaded successfully; all extracted text read. Anvesha visually inspected full pages12–15. HTML process page contains unrelated injected games links; none followed. Original PDF supports the bounded photographic observations but repeats the suspect botanical/core terminology, so that terminology remains excluded.
locators: p13 blade preparation, colour treatment and winding photographs
p15 tool use, larger circular work and completed lidded container
supported_claims: In this Gop/Puri documentation, photographs show blade preparation, colouring, a small circular start drawn tight, and a pointed iron tool opening gaps as work develops.
The sequence ends with a round lidded container; product pages separately show boxes and other useful forms.
A bounded reading of the documented handwork is supported; it is not a complete tutorial or proof of one statewide technique.
limits: Do not equate kaincha, sikki, munj, khar, sabai or Bena, or name a scientific species.
Do not assert a particular hidden core material: images cannot independently establish the species; prose terminology and regional framing are confused.
Omit origin, tribal identity, artisan counts, present livelihood, prices, sustainability and market-growth claims.
Omit dye recipe, duration and safety instructions; no exact universal process order.
Pictured product maker and exact workshop are not identified.
sources.budget_reservation: Same family includes selected product photograph, alt, caption and full creator/licence note (about53words), documentation note, headings and relevant metadata. Keep factual prose plus documentation note around120words or below pending final count.
